restaurantName: Auberge du Pont de la Zorn
address: 2 rue de la République, Weyersheim, 67720, France
bio: Marquetry art from Atelier Spindler, antiques, bleached beams and rough wooden tables: the dining area displays its Alsatian heritage with pride! On the menu: tasty regional specialities, tartes flammées, but also Breton turbot with shrimp bisque and risotto venere, and delicious desserts, like this raspberry-meets-geranium from the garden. Bucolic terrace on the banks of the River Zorn, impeccable welcome and service – this place deserves its success....
pageTitle: Auberge du Pont de la Zorn
